title: SN Nikaya Sutta 1
english: Thus have I heard. At one time the Lord was staying at Savatthi with the monks. On that occasion, the venerable SN1 approached and said: Lord, I inquire about the nature of suffering and the path to liberation. The Blessed One replied: There are four noble truths. The first is suffering. The second is the origin of suffering. The third is the cessation of suffering. The fourth is the path leading to the cessation of suffering. Thus have I heard. At one time the Lord was staying at Savatthi with the monks. On that occasion, the venerable SN1 approached and said: Lord, I inquire about the nature of suffering and the path to liberation.
